# Disruption with Dependabot Alerts

## What Changed

Oct 23, 18:51 UTC Resolved - We identified that an advisory-publication driven fan-out was overwhelming Dependabot alert processing on repositories by saturating the queue with its own events, delaying processing of events related to repository pushes. We have now isolated this fan-out and applied a throttle so it runs at a fixed rate and cannot delay other events. This remediation has successfully prevented a new fan-out process impacting users. Oct 23, 18:36 UTC Monitoring - The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Oct 23, 17:27 UTC Update - Some Dependabot alerts continue to be delayed in closing after repository updates address a vulnerability. We're continuing to investigate and work to restore normal processing. Oct 23, 16:43 UTC Update - We’re continuing to investigate delays in some Dependabot alerts closing after affected repositories are updated. Alert processing remains backed up, and additional processing capacity is rolling out to help reduce the backlog. We’re monitoring progress and will share another update as we learn more.
